Avoid empty talk, which Plotinus called "meaningless clamor". Every sip must be accompanied by awareness of your heavenly origin: "I am a son of Earth and starry Heaven". This turns "grape slop" into the "nectar of the gods", and an ordinary meeting - into a strategic council of demiurges.

advice-bf66479e6253975649207d46.title: The practice of "Gathering Honeyed Nectar"
advice-bf66479e6253975649207d46.body: After any act of transgression or intense experience, immediately fix the insights obtained. The meal of Dionysus ends when the "golden bough" of wisdom is securely fixed in your memory. A conscious person returns from ecstasy filled with the "immortal harvest" of Truth rather than exhausted. If your ecstasy has not brought you new strength, you did not drink with Dionysus; you merely wallowed in Titanic dirt.

advice-de02eee152ddd1fce0adffb9.title: The practice of "Analytical Dissection"
advice-de02eee152ddd1fce0adffb9.body: At moments of surging irrational forces (anger, ecstasy, fear), immediately apply the method of dividing into the "material" and the "causal". Ask yourself: "What is it - that which produces this impression?". Unfold any impulse, dissecting it into its constituent elements, duration and relation to your central strategy. This deprives Chaos of its blinding force, turning a "demonic attack" into dry material for analysis.

advice-59add530f4ea84498b074b85.title: The strategy of "Actor's Sovereignty"
advice-59add530f4ea84498b074b85.body: Remember that your life is a role in a cosmic play, and Logos assigns these roles according to merit. A conscious person does not complain of circumstances, but performs their role to the highest standard, understanding that "each place corresponds to particular characters". Your task is to be the one who carries the divine spark within, rather than to "merge" with the mask, remaining a "god-bearer" who is carried by their own mind along the paths of Logos.

advice-4b8da283ffffa771d906d927.title: The technique of "Intellectual Demarcation"
advice-4b8da283ffffa771d906d927.body: Establish an impenetrable boundary for your ruling principle (Hegemonikon). It must know no turning from the movements of the flesh. As Marcus Aurelius taught: "let the part responsible for assent be at peace, that is, let it judge that this is neither good nor calamity". Your reason is obliged to remain in the state of a "sphere" that shines with its own light and does not reach toward external phantoms, preserving its purity even at the epicenter of struggle.

advice-6c85c7d56f99bad5560bb727.title: The ritual of "Structural Synchronization"
advice-6c85c7d56f99bad5560bb727.body: Align your actions with the standard of the "Straight Logos" every day. A conscious person performs only "right actions" that proceed from a pure source and lead directly to the goal. Everything that violates the communion and order of your inner state must be expelled as "Titanic soot". Power belongs to the one who knows how to be ruthless toward their weakness, turning every day into a triumph of Order over Chaos.

advice-7c9b0e2720a464f12f7bc986.title: The practice of "Invisible Ecstasy"
advice-7c9b0e2720a464f12f7bc986.body: Your activity in the material world must be imbued with the quality of Hades - cold, calculating and impenetrable to the profane. A conscious person "raves" in their creation, but this madness is strictly sealed with the seal of Silence (Sige). Use the energy of your passions for the inner densification of intellectual "tonos" rather than for external noise. One who acts from the point of inner Hades is invulnerable, as their motives are hidden beneath the "helmet of invisibility" of sovereign strategy.

advice-d6e24eca5f3ba9fe60e32711.title: The method of "Creative Sparagmos"
advice-d6e24eca5f3ba9fe60e32711.body: Never fear moments when your plans or structures fragment. Perceive any crisis as a Dionysian rending apart necessary to reassemble the personality at a higher level of complexity. A conscious person welcomes the destruction of old forms, seeing in them the "Titanic dirt" that prevents Nous from shining at full strength. Learn to extract the "gold" of meaning from the ashes of your defeats, remembering that "the Creator, abiding within himself, resembles the Universe".

advice-0f514f655fc864910a37c73e.title: The practice of the "Black Sun"
advice-0f514f655fc864910a37c73e.body: Accustom your reason to seeing the "Hadean reverse" of every success in life. Your wealth, your status and your achievements are merely shadows cast by your immortal principle onto the cave wall. Treat material goods as "gifts of Dionysus" that you sacrifice to your Nous. This frees you from servile attachment, as your true possession is always "There", in the intelligible chamber of Persephone.

advice-02bdc4d829b72233fa0f0702.title: The practice of "Second Birth"
advice-02bdc4d829b72233fa0f0702.body: Live as though you have already "died to the crowd" and your current presence in the world is merely the theurgic act of a god among humans. This grants the right to absolute Dionysian freedom - action without regard for the moral dogmas of the profane and the laws of entropy. One who has passed through the "jaws" of Hades and preserved within themselves the fire of Dionysus's life and ecstasy dictates their own rules to reality, becoming a living embodiment of the eternal Logos.

advice-ab2acc7b27a105b07511fbfc.title: The technique for invoking Zeus: Hymn XV
advice-ab2acc7b27a105b07511fbfc.body: Facet of the psyche: "All-Ruling Mind" and "Universal Law". State: A sense of absolute ontological stability, superiority over any circumstances, and inner silence from which a command proceeds. Method: The direct affirmation "I am the law". Fixing one's ruling principle (Hegemonikon) as the sole legitimate source of will through contemplation of the "golden chain" of divine ranks. Every god is invoked by his "barbarous" or secret name, which, according to Iamblichus, preserves the connection with the primordial source.

advice-7bb8d2710a3bd5612ec8fa5e.title: The technique for invoking Apollo: Hymn XXXIV
advice-7bb8d2710a3bd5612ec8fa5e.body: Facet of the psyche: "Solar Nous" and "Intellectual Harmony". State: Crystal clarity of thought, vision of structural connections behind the veil of phenomena, and aesthetic rapture at the order of the cosmos. Method: Contemplation of the "Sun at midnight". A technique of intellectual focus on the pure source of light within one's own reason, independent of external sensory data. Every god is invoked by his "barbarous" or secret name, which, according to Iamblichus, preserves the connection with the primordial source.

advice-e7b1364cbed80af53cb96436.title: The technique for invoking  Ares: Hymn LXV
advice-e7b1364cbed80af53cb96436.body: Facet of the psyche: "Sacred fury (Menos)". State: The utmost mobilization of all resources, disappearance of the fear of pain and death, readiness to crush obstacles totally. Method: Physically overcoming the limit. Using fury as fuel for a volitional surge and transferring destructive affect into the mode of decisive right action. Every god is invoked by his "barbarous" or secret name, which, according to Iamblichus, preserves the connection with the primordial source.

advice-944d04e8e4d084ceb65cb6e9.title: The technique for invoking Athena: Hymn XXXII
advice-944d04e8e4d084ceb65cb6e9.body: Facet of the psyche: "Cold strategy" and "Intellectual light-bearing knowledge". State: Perfect emotional detachment, the ability to make calculating decisions at the epicenter of battle, relying exclusively on Logos. Method: Analytical dissection of Chaos. The practice of dividing any event into the causal and the material, "removing the armor" from a situation to lay bare its naked logic. Every god is invoked by his "barbarous" or secret name, which, according to Iamblichus, preserves the connection with the primordial source.

advice-a51ad2752e0e3768fb0e310e.title: The technique for invoking Hermes: Hymn XXVIII
advice-a51ad2752e0e3768fb0e310e.body: Facet of the psyche: "Intuitive passage" and "Guide of meanings". State: Flexibility of mind, the ability to change roles instantly, and elusiveness to an external observer in any social environment. Method: The practice of intellectual invisibility. Using the "helmet of Hades" (secret knowledge) to move through the world without losing connection with one's own guardian daimon. Every god is invoked by his "barbarous" or secret name, which, according to Iamblichus, preserves the connection with the primordial source.

advice-3d05eb8136de1a1334d912b7.title: The technique for invoking Dionysus: Hymn XXX
advice-3d05eb8136de1a1334d912b7.body: Facet of the psyche: "Thrice-born fullness" and "Axis Mundi". State: Plotinus's "sober intoxication", in which the soul raves with love for the One, acquiring the status of a god instead of a mortal. Method: "Sober intoxication" and awareness of oneself as the axis of the world. A technique of controlled entry into transgressive states while preserving the motionless center of the observer. Every god is invoked by his "barbarous" or secret name, which, according to Iamblichus, preserves the connection with the primordial source.

advice-31ca510510f6cc9016efa05e.title: The technique for invoking Hera: Hymn XVI
advice-31ca510510f6cc9016efa05e.body: Facet of the psyche: "Ontological dignity". State: Royal self-possession and awareness of oneself as air (Nega-aeg), filling and binding all the structures of consciousness. Method: Direct affirmation of one's sovereign rank and right to co-rule reality on equal terms with the supreme Mind. Every god is invoked by his "barbarous" or secret name, which, according to Iamblichus, preserves the connection with the primordial source.

advice-796e7dfc559f5d82682fc52f.title: The technique for invoking Poseidon: Hymn XVII
advice-796e7dfc559f5d82682fc52f.body: Facet of the psyche: "The might of elemental breakthrough". State: The energy of unconscious depths and the force capable both of shaking foundations (Ennosigaios) and of serving as unbreakable bonds for Chaos. Method: Working with the inner «waters» and fixing the foundation of the personality by calming mental storms. Every god is invoked by his "barbarous" or secret name, which, according to Iamblichus, preserves the connection with the primordial source.

advice-a1ece471a866537d114a2941.title: The technique for invoking Demeter: Hymn XL
advice-a1ece471a866537d114a2941.body: Facet of the psyche: "The ancestral memory of the earth". State: The nourishing power of Logos and the establishment of unshakable laws (Thesmophoria) within psychic space. Method: Synchronization with the cycles of renewal and awareness of the continuity of one's intellectual and biological lineage. Every god is invoked by his "barbarous" or secret name, which, according to Iamblichus, preserves the connection with the primordial source.

advice-ad523c7a915848b7b4effa5a.title: The technique for invoking Artemis: Hymn XXXVI
advice-ad523c7a915848b7b4effa5a.body: Facet of the psyche: "Virgin independence". State: The utmost autonomy of Nous, untouched by external influences, and purity of intention. Method: The practice of "intellectual hunting" - concentrating the entire will at a single point (arrow) aimed at the object of cognition. Every god is invoked by his "barbarous" or secret name, which, according to Iamblichus, preserves the connection with the primordial source.

advice-8811f907dfc8cf80e0405a13.title: The technique for invoking Aphrodite: Hymn LV
advice-8811f907dfc8cf80e0405a13.body: Facet of the psyche: "Cosmic Eros". State: The force of attraction that binds disparate elements into a harmonious whole, and the ecstasy of contemplating beauty. Method: Cultivating aesthetic rapture and recognizing Eros as a mediator who raises reason to the divine world. Every god is invoked by his "barbarous" or secret name, which, according to Iamblichus, preserves the connection with the primordial source.

advice-e114a859b0fe1be03f01ea5c.title: The technique for invoking Hephaestus: Hymn LXVI
advice-e114a859b0fe1be03f01ea5c.body: Facet of the psyche: "Creative mastery". State: "Fiery Nous", capable of melting down the crude matter of experience into perfect instruments of power and cognition. Method: Transforming affects through the «forge» of active logic, giving form to chaotic impulses. Every god is invoked by his "barbarous" or secret name, which, according to Iamblichus, preserves the connection with the primordial source.

advice-0022b989f6aca0d733d15f45.title: The technique for invoking Hestia: Hymn LXXXIV
advice-0022b989f6aca0d733d15f45.body: Facet of the psyche: "The motionless center". State: The stability of the ruling principle (Hegemonikon) and the sealing of the inner Adyton against the noise of the external world. Method: Maintaining the "sacred fire" of attention at the very center of one's being, without leaving the «home» of the gods for the sake of temporary phantoms. Every god is invoked by his "barbarous" or secret name, which, according to Iamblichus, preserves the connection with the primordial source.

advice-ea2399a4a61533ef2c4ba78d.title: The Magic of Hymnography as an "Instrument of Mind"
advice-ea2399a4a61533ef2c4ba78d.body: Use the reading of Orphic hymns as a "verbal sacrifice". A conscious person does not ask the gods for mercy, but "draws" their presence through likeness. Repeat the hymn in a state of "intellectual sobriety" until you feel your spirit become "light and cross space upward". If you invoke Ares, your blood must boil with fire; if you invoke Apollo, your mind must become crystal clear.

advice-a60ce90f4c02283ea44d9dc9.title: The practice of "Discovering the Daimon"
advice-a60ce90f4c02283ea44d9dc9.body: Before entering the Entheosis of the thirteen, fix your "individual lot". Ask yourself: "For what am I now using my soul?". Your daimon is the one who "stands behind the doors" and does not let the "inner crowd" seize power. Treat it as a "tutor" that filters divine energies so that they do not burn your mortal composition. Without this "intermediate layer", you risk becoming food for the "avenging demons" which, in the expression of the Hermetic texts, "apply a fiery needle to a human being".
